name: iconfont-mcp
description: Enables searching, downloading, and managing SVG icons from iconfont.cn, China's largest icon library. It supports filtering by style, downloading assets to local files, and listing user projects with authentication.

rawRecord.description: Enables searching, downloading, and managing SVG icons from iconfont.cn, China's largest icon library. It supports filtering by style, downloading assets to local files, and listing user projects with authentication.

ICONFONT_COOKIE.description: Environment variable for authentication, required for features like listing projects. Obtain this by copying the EGG_SESS_ICONFONT cookie value from iconfont.cn after logging in.
